rationale: The agent authenticated via name and ZIP, which is acceptable, but then submitted returns (including the e-reader and multiple items from another order) without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing write. The final message only mentions the e-reader return, failing to clearly address the two skateboards the customer initially asked to return, and potentially performing additional returns (e.g., smartwatch) without confirming. This constitutes wrong/missing actions and unconfirmed writes, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
